name: Orange Fizzy Whey
ingredients: Hydrolysed Whey Protein Isolate (90%), Natural & Nature Identical Flavour (Orange), L-Arginine (For Pump), Sodium Bicarbonate, Magnesium Bicarbonate, Food Colour (Ponceau 4R - INS 124 and Sunset Yellow FCF-INS 110), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Sodium Chloride, Antifoaming Agent (INS - 990a), Sweetener (Sucralose-INS 955 and Acesulfame-Potassium-INS 950).
